Strip newlines produces single-line paragraphs

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>First paragraph.</p><p>Second paragraph.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(strip_newlines: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
